title: Theatrical Maquettes by Marcel Jambon
content: Marcel Jambon, Set design model for Giuseppe Verdi's Otello, 1895Marcel Jambon (1848–1908) was a French scenic designer who built maquettes to plan his theatrical sets.Marcel Jambon, set design for Tristan and IsoldeA wooden frame supported painted backdrops.Seeing the sets in 3D allowed him to check the viewing angles and the lighting options of a given set design.Ariane: built model of act V / by Marcel JambonScenic designers often have a variety of skills in drawing, painting, sculpting, and lighting, and they work closely with the other people in the production, including the director, lighting designer, choreographer, and costume designer.----Wikipedia onScenic Design
